body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Inada Family Massage Chair recently announced that it had participated to 'CES 2011', the world's largest IT show in Las Vegas on Jan 7~9.
Inada Family had exhibited 'SOGNO' which was popular in American market for 2010 at this CES 2011.

Cliff Levin, a representative of North American Market of Inada Family, expressed his self-respect proud saying "Recovering from fatigue by relaxing body and releasing the tension of muscles is important for every people. We are contributing to health of people in America through 'SOGNO'"

'SOGNO' is the creative and indoor interior-friendly massage chair, a result of 'Design Management' of Family of Japan and supporting massage functionality wrapping whole arms plus shoulder, hip, pelvis, legs and feet etc. and Air massage functionality.
Air Push Solid Roller Massage functionality realizes rich feeling of malaxation by pressing malaxation ball using the power of air and the strength can be adjustable.
